content:
Fiscal Q4 DRAM revenue was a record $39.8 billion, up 343% year over year, and represented 73% of total

revenue. Sequentially, DRAM revenue increased 27%. Bit shipments were up mid-single-digit percentage

range. Prices increased high-teens percentage range, driven by tight DRAM industry conditions.

NAND

Fiscal Q4 NAND revenue was a record $14.1 billion, up 526% year over year, and represented 26% of total

revenue. Sequentially, NAND revenue increased 42%. Bit shipments increased approximately 10%. Prices

increased approximately 30%, driven by tight NAND industry conditions.
